# Manuel Echavarria Romero — Industrial & Product Designer

> Industrial and product designer with 15 years of experience across 6 countries. Product development from insight and concept through to manufacturing, distribution and launch: consumer products, retail and point of sale, brand innovation, physical and digital. Co-founded three companies, one sold. Based in Kuala Lumpur, working remotely for Spain and the EU.

Manuel Echavarria Romero (also known as **Manecharo** or **MER**) is an industrial designer and product developer trained in Milan (IED, SPD). He has designed consumer products, point-of-sale systems, furniture, doors and hydroponic systems, led design teams and in-house R&D, and built digital products. Every figure he publishes comes from a project that reached the market.

Canonical site: https://manecharo.com — available in Spanish (/es), English (/en) and Italian (/it).
Working languages: Spanish, English, Italian, French.

## What he does

- **Industrial design**: consumer products, retail fixtures and point-of-sale systems; concept, form, CMF, prototyping, design for manufacturing.
- **Product development**: from insight to engineering hand-off, cost engineering, suppliers, manufacturing and launch.
- **Brand innovation**: brand identity and experience, shopper and POP systems.
- **Digital product**: UX/UI and design systems.

## Selected results

- −70% technology cost — Mill (point-of-sale system).
- 65% cheaper than the imported system, more than 1,000 units sold — Paqua (hydroponic systems; co-founder).
- 400+ artisans trained — Artesanías de Colombia.
- 1.4 M views in the first year — KUASA.
